description: This file contains unit tests for the 'config compaction settings' feature, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It tests loading and resetting configuration states related to compaction settings in a system, including memory flush, override values, default modes, safeguard values, and retry configurations.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up test environment by resetting configuration runtime state before each test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleans up test environment by resetting configuration runtime state after each test.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for various aspects of the configuration compaction settings.
